<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Mentor of Legends](/Feats.aspx?ID=5333) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 32

</column>

---

You're an extraordinary teacher, capable of inspiring your students to amazing feats of athletics and ingenuity. Once per day, you can cast [_heroism_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1555) as an innate divine spell; in addition to its normal effects, the spell also grants temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. You can't cast this spell on yourself.
